no_mask.p2_rule_retired: D(t) <= S(t) on >= 90% of steps, both channels, both shapes; a P2 fail cancels the outcome run, a P2 pass admits nothing; the outcome run decides. Retired 2026-10-01 by Fable: unsatisfiable under an exchangeable null: per-step P(D<=S) = 1/5; fails a correct candidate at step 1 where S = 0 (perf lane's AUDIT/tierb-nomask-2026-10-01/p2_null_sim.out: 0 of 200 null candidates pass).
no_mask.p2_rule: P2 (amended 2026-10-01 by Fable; supersedes the D(t)<=S(t)-on->=90%-of-steps rule, which no exchangeable null can satisfy: per step P(D<=S) = C(3,2)/C(6,2) = 1/5, distribution-free). Arms: the 3 masked baselines B_j and the 3 no-mask candidates M_i of one shape, default kernels, same batches. Refuse (no verdict) unless: >= 3 baselines and >= 1 candidate; one consumed_digest; equal steps and channel lengths; every arm termination == 'steps_exhausted'; every baseline row train_attention_mask == 'padding' and every candidate row == 'none'. Per channel in (letter, span): live = steps where any arm is non-zero; a channel with no live step is not_run. Per step set T in {first live step, all live steps}: bbar(t) = mean_j B_j(t); L = mean over T of bbar(t), L > 0 else not_run; dev_i = mean over T of (M_i(t) - bbar(t)) / L per candidate; noise_j = mean over T of (B_j(t) - mean_{k!=j} B_k(t)) / L per baseline; dev = max_i |dev_i|; noise = max_j |noise_j|; tau = 0.02; kappa = 3. Verdict(channel, T) = inconclusive if noise > tau/kappa; else fail if dev > tau; else pass. Channel = worst over T; shape = any fail -> fail, else any not_run -> not_run, else any inconclusive -> inconclusive, else pass. Gate: item 9 goes iff both shapes' latest verdict is pass. fail cancels it. not_run or missing cancels it until a rerun. inconclusive holds it for the human: not a fail, the gate stays closed, no override flag, env var or --tau; the human either amends tau here (recorded) and the lane changes the module constant by commit and recomputes --p2 from the saved result rows (no GPU), so the new verdict row supersedes, or drops the candidate. A pass admits nothing; the outcome run decides. The verdict row records tau, kappa and, per (channel, T): L, every dev_i, every noise_j, dev, noise; each arm's train_path; and the per-step profile (median and max of D and S, fraction D<=S, first step with D > max S, final losses), all report-only. Calibration, by CPU simulation against the implemented function, committed under AUDIT/tierb-nomask-2026-10-01/ before any GPU P2 session: exchangeable null at the p2_null_sim noise model (n=100 and n=50, 3v3 and 3v1, with and without bit-identical baseline forwards): pass >= 99%, fail 0; the same null at noise x3, x10, x20, x100: fail <= 12% at every multiplier, the split reported; all candidates x(1+delta): delta 0.5% pass >= 99%, delta 2% fail >= 95%, delta 4% fail >= 99%; one candidate x1.04 with two null: fail >= 99%; step-1-only x1.03 with bit-identical baseline forwards: fail >= 99%, and x1.01: pass >= 99%; Gaussian single-application worst case of P(fail | null) over sigma/tau: <= 4.5%.
